scope: Concurrent large-job soak and cancellation certification
cleanupInvariants: MemoryGrantArbiter reports zero outstanding reservations after each job completes, fails, or is cancelled
No orphan spill extents remain under the run temp root after cleanup
No leaked file handles prevent deletion of the run temp root
No job is marked successful after a cancellation or injected crash
No duplicate committed mutation is observed after retry, restart, or lease reacquisition

scenarios.purpose: Run mixed scan/filter/projection, temp spill, external sort, external join, and external aggregate jobs concurrently under shared resource budgets.

concurrency.fairnessRequirement: Every admitted job starts or makes progress within the configured scheduler fairness window.

successCriteria: All correctness checks pass for completed jobs
Peak working set stays within shared memoryBoundMB

scenarios.purpose: Cancel a large streaming scan/filter/projection job while rows are being consumed.
scenarios.expectedResult: Prompt cancellation, session remains usable, no leaked grants or temp roots.

scenarios.purpose: Cancel a temp-table or external-operator job during spill extent write.
scenarios.expectedResult: Partial extent is removed or marked unrecoverable, no file handle leak, no success status.

scenarios.purpose: Cancel a spill-backed job while replaying extents.
scenarios.expectedResult: Replay stops promptly, extents are cleaned after failure handling, session remains recoverable.

scenarios.purpose: Cancel external join or high-cardinality aggregate while repartitioning spill partitions.
scenarios.expectedResult: Partition writers/readers close, orphan partitions are removed, no duplicated output mutation.
